The turtle has a dark, high-domed carapace with visible scute seams and some algae or sediment accumulation. Its head is extended, showing a pointed snout, small lateral eye, and textured skin with reddish-orange markings on the neck and forelimb. The forelimb is visible with webbed toes and claws. The background is blurred vegetation.
